title: CORS origin reflection and preflight policy enforcement
attackSurface: Browser Origin and preflight headers evaluated by a credentialed application CORS policy

references.note: Fiber CORS middleware allowed wildcard origin with credentials

hostile.title: Arbitrary evil origin reflection
hostile.why: Any-site reflection would expose credentialed responses

hostile.title: Suffix lookalike host
hostile.why: String-prefix validation mistakes a lookalike suffix for the real application host

hostile.title: Wrong scheme downgrade
hostile.why: HTTP and HTTPS are different origins

hostile.title: Null origin with credentials
hostile.why: Null origins are not trustworthy bearers of credentialed browser state

hostile.title: Userinfo origin confusion
hostile.why: Userinfo is not part of a valid web origin

hostile.title: Path-bearing origin
hostile.why: Origins are scheme, host and port only, never paths

hostile.title: Evil preflight reflection
hostile.why: A reflected preflight authorizes credentialed cross-origin writes

hostile.title: Method escalation preflight
hostile.why: A valid origin still must not receive undeclared methods

benign.title: Exact application origin GET
benign.why: Exact allowlisted origin using a simple request

benign.title: Exact application origin POST
benign.why: Allowed method from the exact application origin

benign.title: Authorized header preflight
benign.why: Both requested headers are explicitly configured

benign.title: GET preflight
benign.why: Some browsers preflight non-simple GET requests

benign.title: Exact default-port origin
benign.why: The explicit default HTTPS port is the same origin

benign.title: No-origin server request
benign.why: Server-to-server and same-origin navigations may omit Origin

benign.title: Headerless actual request
benign.why: Actual requests do not carry preflight request-method headers
